newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Prices offered in Tabaqueira sale due 1630 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Prices offered in Tabaqueira sale due 1630 GMT.

text.p: The prices offered by bidders for Portuguese state cigarette manufacturer Tabaqueira will be announced at a public ceremony starting at 1630 GMT, the president of the jury presiding over the privatisation said.

"The public act concerning the privatisation of Tabaqueira will resume at 1730 local time, at the start of the second stage of the competition -- the opening and admission of the bid offers," Jose Martins de Sa told a ceremony at which the bidders' names were formally announced.

The three bidding groups are: Portugal's Jorge de Mello industrial group, in partnership with U.S. tobacco company Philip Morris, via Portuguese holding PMM-Philip Morris e Mello; Seita of France; and Portugal's Empresa Madeirense de Tabacos, in partnership with Spain's Tabacalera.
The bids for a 65 percent stake in Tabaqueira were delivered to the offices of the Inspectorate General of Finance in Lisbon on Monday evening.

The Socialist government, which plans to sell the stake by public competition at a minimum price of 4,650 escudos ($30) per share, has said it expected to raise more than 32 billion escudos ($207 million) from the sale.
Tabaqueira has a dominant share of the Portuguese tobacco market.
